goals: Locally authored exact differential requiring native output with an explicit 65536-byte small-island threshold.
Failed islands x={a,b}, y={b,c} and successful good={c,d} overlap without granting co-activation.
Evaluation-only selected import targets keep their native owners at both byte thresholds; clustering must not absorb their complete initializer closure.
User-thrown ReferenceError is not the waived TDZ case; its object and thrown undefined are cached per failed module while unrelated initialization remains usable.
